headline: Nevish Line Bleeds Heavily as Linn Mercy Ground Shifts
war_summary: Since the last edition the Linn Mercy front has been redrawn: the Colonials now hold eight works there to two Warden and one unclaimed, where the district previously stood almost wholly in Colonial hands, with Lathair its busiest station at twenty-five actions in the day. The Nevish Line has likewise shifted in part, standing four Warden works to three Colonial and one unclaimed, yet it is now the war's costliest ground, near 582 Colonial and 1,024 Warden casualties in the past hour alone. Weathered Expanse holds at five Warden, two Colonial and two unclaimed, its guns the busiest of any district across the day though quiet in the last two hours, the fighting centred on Spirit Watch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest. Marban Hollow stands four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, its front fallen quiet since the small hours. Mooring County remains entirely Warden, twelve works, The Wind Hills its principal scene. Stonecradle reports sharp losses about The Reach and World's End against scant ground gained. Callahan's Passage still carries the heaviest cumulative toll of the war. The wider map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
